question: Where does a work set in the Jiangshi Web paracosm (near-future AI, Chinese folklore and Daoist cosmology, climate breakdown, horror turning to a new xianxia) meet readers, and in which forms: a literary novel, a serial, a Mandarin original?

qualities.literary: Marketed and reviewed as literary fiction (prizes, literary press, sentence-level ambition).
qualities.horror: Marketed or shelved as horror, including weird and cosmic horror.
qualities.folk-horror: Draws its dread from a folklore and its rites.
qualities.chinese-folklore: Uses Chinese folklore, Daoist cosmology or Chinese religion as working machinery.
qualities.near-future: Set within roughly twenty-five years of publication, in a world recognizably ours.
qualities.ai-central: Machine intelligence is central to the plot, not background.
qualities.climate-central: Climate or ecological breakdown is central to the plot.
qualities.progression: A legible power or cultivation system the protagonist climbs.
qualities.serialized: First published as a serial or web novel.
qualities.long-series: Runs to more than three volumes.

demands.segment: English readers of literary and weird horror who follow AI and climate

for.claim: US horror sales rose 24.2% in 2023 and about 13% in 2025 (Circana BookScan); science fiction and horror performed well in adult fiction in Q1 2026 while total units fell 3.1%.
Automated traffic passed human traffic on the web in 2024 (51%, bad bots 37%): the book's premise is a measured fact, not a conceit.
'Chinamaxxing' (becoming Chinese) spread on TikTok from late 2025 into 2026, after the REDnote migration of early 2025: English-speaking attention to Chinese daily practice is at a high.

against.claim: Chinese science fiction translated since 2019 (Waste Tide, Hospital among them) has not reached the reception of the 2014-18 Three-Body wave.

demands.segment: English web-serial readers of progression fantasy and cosmic horror

for.claim: Lord of the Mysteries, a serialized Chinese web novel of cosmic horror with a legible ascent system, passed 100 million reads and an animated adaptation (2025).
Progression fantasy grew into a large self-published market on Kindle Unlimited, Royal Road and Audible; cultivation series average 11 or more volumes.

demands.segment: Mandarin readers of literary speculative fiction outside mainland China

for.claim: Han Song, whose Hospital trilogy is surreal AI-and-medicine horror, is among the most prominent living Chinese science fiction writers: the literary register has Mandarin readers.
